import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
candidate=pathlib.Path(os.environ['SC071_CANDIDATE_ROOT'])
base=pathlib.Path(os.environ['SC071_BASE_ROOT'])
paths=('package.json','package-lock.json')
original=('48a22ef6a0d0389d41fe079043845fb61372263d842ad8de83d09b4e754a3878',
          '93ab57ed8646227fbfd7e45b3df908c3a6411729d0170c3fcca2c02b54f48627')
source_map_fix=('51fb820a7f765c0fb3a383bb367c802d76f53a8cea79759f0ea3704fd552a2de',
                'de5a6ebeb93dff909fe2526cd724e8abc4b6b580233d4271b668ec6b0fe7097b')
def hashes(root):return tuple(hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths)
# Keep immutable BASE packages. Permit only its exact original pair
# or the independently reviewed source-map-js 1.2.2 security repair.
# Mixed pairs and every other dependency change remain fail-closed.
base_pair,candidate_pair=hashes(base),hashes(candidate)
assert base_pair==original,'sc071_base_dependency_inputs_changed'
assert candidate_pair in (original,source_map_fix),'sc071_candidate_dependency_inputs_unqualified'
expected='1.2.2' if candidate_pair==source_map_fix else '1.2.1'
installed=subprocess.check_output(['node','-p',"require('source-map-js/package.json').version"],cwd=candidate,text=True).strip()
assert installed==expected,'sc071_installed_source_map_version_mismatch'
receipt={'dependency_install':'candidate npm ci; immutable BASE package pair plus exact reviewed source-map-js security compatibility',
         'base_package_sha256':dict(zip(paths,base_pair)),
         'candidate_package_sha256':dict(zip(paths,candidate_pair)),
         'compatibility':'SOURCE_MAP_JS_1_2_2_SECURITY_FIX' if candidate_pair==source_map_fix else 'BYTE_IDENTICAL_ORIGINAL',
         'actual_installed_source_map_js':installed,'base_packages_modified':False}
(pathlib.Path(os.environ['SC071_EVIDENCE'])/'dependency-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
